integrity: The general proof is symbolic; exhaustive finite support-graph checks for products of two through five fields are included only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: Reducedness and finiteness of the minimal-prime set are assumed.
The theorem does not address nonreduced rings or rings with infinitely many minimal primes.
A 2014 Artinian theorem gives the same parity formula on the Artinian subclass.
title: Paired domination of annihilating-ideal graphs of reduced rings with finite minimal spectrum
